Ramayana Film Nears ₹1,500 Crore Box Office Milestone

The film 'Ramayana' is approaching a box office collection of ₹1,500 crore by its 13th day of release. The film's earnings are being closely watched, with projections suggesting it may soon surpass the performance of 'Pushpa 2'.
